goal: Allow scheduling future transaction broadcasts by block height directly through the node
Helps users conceal transaction creation timing and broadcast timelocked transactions without custom scripts
agreement: Objections have been addressed, but no reviewers have endorsed the PR yet
Questioned whether broadcast delays should be handled by client wallets instead (ismaelsadeeq)
Concerned that default wallet locktimes defeat privacy, prompting a timelock rework (vasild)
Noted that queued transactions are lost on node restart, which the author left for a followup (vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it improves timing privacy against network observers for users with sensitive transactions
Benefit is moderate and confined to nodes using private broadcast for future locktimes

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it saves RPC users from maintaining external schedulers or daemons for future locktimes
Impact is limited to callers needing delayed transaction submission
